recurrence_mechanism.no_embedding_similarity: Pure identifier equality on values Aurora's own contract/ledger already produced -- no new similarity scoring was added.

individual_identity_preservation.claim: Each fail event remains individually distinguishable -- order preserved, not flattened into one aggregate, not scattered as fully isolated unrelated objects.
